notes.title: Rail Adventures is now in Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After a pause/break we are back in full time development.
Rail Adventures is now in Early Access:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/272920/Rail_Adventures/

Also, you can download and play a free beta from our website:
http://exosyphen.com/page_railadventures.html

There is no VR support yet, but it will be added very soon.

notes.title: Support us on IndieGoGo and let's make this bigger than ever
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is a Tech Demo for our upcoming 3D and VR game, Rail Adventures.
The purpose is for us to gather feedback and make sure we get the VR and gaming experience right, and for you to enjoy the beauty of the game.

Have fun and please send us your feedback :)

Support us on IndieGogo:

https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/rail-adventures-racing/x/1611152#/


Visit the official game here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/272920/
